label: Northern Weddell ice-gradient sampling transect
selection_note: Chosen for prospective ice-gradient measurement after inspecting a dated OSI-SAF observation. Do not score earlier forecast bulletins on this selected line.
limitations: This is a geodesic research sampling line, not an ECDIS passage plan or safe vessel route.

One line and one observation cannot establish forecast skill or calibrated uncertainty.
